source: NSE Clearing: phased delivery margin on physically settled stock derivatives in the last four trading days before expiry (percentage of VaR + ELM).
note: The staggered 10/25/45/70 percent also appears in a broker physical-settlement policy and a broker help article (secondary), but a broker community post citing a January 2020 circular shows 100 percent at E-1. The NSE Clearing circular itself was not read, so the schedule stays unverified.
appliesTo: Physically settled stock futures and in-the-money stock options (NFO and BFO). Index derivatives are cash settled and carry no delivery margin.
